verdict.rationale: Close's homepage says reporting is built into the platform alongside pipeline management. That is a first-party, in-product capability, but it is a single thin mention. The developer docs cover pulling reporting metrics and pipeline data out through the API into BI tools or custom-built dashboards. That is a developer building block that amounts to exporting, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: documented native dashboard builder, specific pipeline/activity/conversion report types, custom report configuration details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can build reports and dashboards on pipeline, activity, and conversion without exporting to a spreadsheet

citations.quote: It combines calling, email, SMS, pipeline management, reporting, and an AI sales agent named Chloe into a single platform.
